"""Render the console this platform serves at "/" -- without node, without network.

The Dockerfile runs ``python frontend/build.py`` while it builds the image, so
this script is standard-library-only and network-free by construction: no npm,
no bundler, no package download, no ``pip install``. It assembles

    frontend/shell.template.html        the page shell: markup, CSS, and the
                                        generic console engine
  + frontend/src/App.tsx                the PLATFORM block (product name,
                                        screens in order, operator settings,
                                        route reference)
  + frontend/src/modules/*.tsx          one SCREEN block per screen
  + docs/declared_locale.json           the country and currency the customer
                                        declared, never invented here

into ``app/static/index.html``, the file ``app/main.py`` serves at ``/``.

The modules are the source of truth for what the console offers: each screen
declares its capability surfaces (id, live/placeholder, the fields

accepts), and this script refuses to build a page that names a route or a
capability the platform does not answer.

"""The platform's capability models.

Every capability carries the shared envelope -- ``reference`` (its own
human handle) and ``status`` (the schema-enforced vocabulary open /
in_progress / closed) -- plus the fields its vertical needs.  ``FIELDS``
is what the factory's probes build a payload from; ``CONSTRAINTS`` is what
the route enforces, so a payload built from the spec is one the route
accepts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, ClassVar, Dict, List, Optional

STATUS_VOCABULARY = ("open", "in_progress", "closed")


class _Base:
    """Shared envelope behaviour for every capability model."""

    CAPABILITY_ID: ClassVar[str] = ""
    ENTITY: ClassVar[str] = ""
    FIELDS: ClassVar[List[str]] = []
    CONSTRAINTS: ClassVar[Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    MONEY_FIELDS: ClassVar[tuple] = ()

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Read storage/caller data back into the declared shape.

        Unknown keys are dropped, missing keys become ``None``: the shape is
        the model's, never the caller's.
        """
        source = dict(data or {})
        out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        for name in cls.FIELDS:
            out[name] = source.get(name)
        for extra in ("id", "tenant_id", "created_at", "updated_at"):
            if extra in source:
                out[extra] = source[extra]
        return out

    @classmethod
    def to_dict(cls) -> Dict[str, Any]:  # pragma: no cover - shape helper
        return {name: getattr(self, name, None) for name in cls.FIELDS}


def _envelope(status_field: str = "status") -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
    return {
        "reference": {"required": True, "type": "str"},
        status_field: {

            "type": "str",

    async def create(request: Request) -> Any:

        refusal_body = _placeholder_refusal(capability_id)
        if refusal_body is not None:
            from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

            return JSONResponse(status_code=503, content=refusal_body)
        payload = await _payload_of(request)
        problem = validate_payload(capability_id, payload)
        if problem is not None:

        outcome = module_of(capability_id).handle(dict(payload))
        if not isinstance(outcome, dict) or outcome.get("ok") is False:
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "capability": capability_id,
                "error": str((outcome or {}).get("error") or "the capability refused"),
                "block": (outcome or {}).get("block"),
                "stored": None,

        stored = store.save(

    create.__name__ = "create_" + capability_id
    return create

"""A platform that computes money computes it for the locale the USER declared.

FinOps (sess_065fc3eac75c4f62) was a finance platform for a Dubai business.

was wrong for the UAE.
